title: Church Observation
prompt:
Rhea and Seteth watch from the edge of the academy training ground after the mock battle. Rhea appears serene, almost satisfied; Seteth remains cautious. The Blue Lions are small in the distance, recovering from training. The feeling is surveillance, not celebration.

Camera: long-lens compressed hold with a subtle drift from students to Rhea and Seteth. Rhea must remain a breathtakingly beautiful young adult woman in her mid-20s with smooth youthful skin; express ancient dragon divinity through calm sacred authority, not wrinkles, eye bags, tired texture, or middle-aged features.
